cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Images: 30 per hour and 150 per day; video: 6 per hour and 20 per day (429 too_many)
trial_over, agent_cap and no_credits at a zero balance open the limit dialog

no_credits with a balance left shows 'Needs N credits; you have M.' with a top-up pack link (paid owner) or plans link (trial owner); anyone else is told to ask the owner; plan_required and trial_video_used show a billing link
Refused before the charge: no credit moves. After the charge, a failed render is refunded exactly once, back to its top-up pack when it came from one

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Prompts come from a fixed brand template and the render is still charged
The controls say images and videos are made from a fixed description of your brand, not from this post
PowerPoint needs no model call and no credits, so it works while paused

cards.title: Who can do this
items: Any signed-in owner or team member; images on social, ads, gbp, whatsapp and cart_recovery items, video on social and ads
Only styles this deployment can run are offered: provider key, a Blob store for kie and Higgsfield, listed in MEDIA_MODELS_ON, not switched off by the breaker
Trials get one video clip, in the Quick, Sound or Photo to motion styles
Limit dialog: a paid owner gets 'Top up credits', a trial owner 'View plans'; for agent_cap, whoever may change Governance gets 'Open Governance'; others ask the owner
